_help: Boards: the slug from the board URL (job-boards.greenhouse.io/<slug>, jobs.lever.co/<slug>, jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug>). Check new ones with: python -m jobpilot collect run --dry-run; peviitor: search words (+ optional city, rows, pages) on the peviitor.ro aggregator - links to boards already listed are skipped, other Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby boards become suggestions (collect suggest), company sites are kept and their description is read from the job page (describe_limit per run)
